Questions

Before we go live

Is it really live?

Yes. This is a live-only event and there will be no replay. Aiden will share his screen to show you the behind-the-scenes of this business, including real numbers and live listings from our portfolio.

How much money do I need?

There is no set starting amount, but Aiden likely wouldn't go into this venture with less than $40,000. This is a business opportunity, not a get-rich-quick scheme. If you treat it as such you will be successful.

Do I need to live near my Airbnb properties?

No. With the systems you will learn about in this training, this can be managed 100% remotely. Aiden hasn't seen 98% of our properties.

Do I need real estate experience?

No. The training starts from your very first property. No experience necessary.

Isn't Airbnb getting too saturated?

No. And it never will be. You will never look at Airbnb or saturation the same within the first 10 minutes of this live event.

How much time does this take each week?

With the right systems in place it can be managed in a few hours a week.

What happens after I register?

Your seat is saved. Check your inbox for your join link and calendar invite, accept it, and show up live on Wednesday at 7:00 PM ET.

What devices can I use?

Any device works. We recommend a desktop or laptop, since Aiden will be sharing his screen.
